title: Beautiful 5BR Rosemary Beach Home with a Private Pool
meta_description: Relax at Kingston Beach Club, a beautiful 5BR, 4BA Rosemary Beach home, with a private pool & beach access, an EV charger, and cruiser bikes. Sleeps 14.
description_expanded: DescriptionWhat Guests Love- Private heated pool with waterfall feature, stone patio, and turf sundeck- Four complimentary beach cruiser bikes for exploring the 30A trail- Private beach access — no public parking lots or crowded access points- Free EV charger on-site (JuiceBox) included with your stay- Walking distance to Rosemary Beach Town Square, shops, and dining- Vaulted great room with exposed beams and wall of windows overlooking the pool- Gourmet kitchen with gas range, wine fridge, and quartz countertops — seats 13- Sleeps 14 across 3 kings, a bunk room, and a twin/trundle — ideal for large groupsFew homes on 30A combine a resort-caliber pool setup with a walkable Rosemary Beach address and a design that earns compliments the moment you walk in. Kingston Beach Club is a five-bedroom, professionally designed home that sleeps 14 comfortably — with four complimentary beach cruisers waiting in the driveway and private beach access around the corner.THE HOMEThe great room sets the tone immediately: soaring vaulted ceilings with exposed wood beams, honey-colored hardwood floors, and a wall of floor-to-ceiling windows that frames the pool like a painting. Slip-covered sofas surround a large HDTV, and the entire space opens onto the backyard. The dining table seats eight, with an additional five seats at the peninsula bar — enough room for your whole group to eat together. The kitchen is built to cook in: gas range, full-size refrigerator, wine fridge, in-drawer microwave, dishwasher, and custom wood cabinetry with quartz countertops throughout. Approximately 2,774 square feet total.BEDROOMSThe primary suite is on the main level and features a king bed, a seating area with HDTV, walk-in closet, and an ensuite bath with double vanity and oversized step-in shower. Also on the main level: a second king guest room and a twin bedroom with a twin trundle — ideal for kids or a solo traveler needing their own space. Upstairs, the fourth bedroom offers a king bed with a private ensuite bath. The bunk room sleeps six across a full-over-full bunk and a separate full bed, and opens onto a second-floor balcony with views of the pool and courtyard below.LAYOUTMain level: great room, dining, kitchen, laundry, primary suite, king guest room, twin/trundle room, full bath, pool accessUpper level: king suite with ensuite bath, bunk room sleeping six, balcony, full bathOUTDOOR SPACESThe backyard is where this home earns its reputation. The heated pool features a waterfall accent, and the surrounding patio combines paved stone with vibrant turf grass — plenty of room to spread out in the sun or pull into the shade. Pool heat is available upon request.AMENITIES- Private heated pool (heat available upon 24-hour notice w/ fee)- Private beach access- Four complimentary beach cruiser bikes- Free EV charger on-site (JuiceBox)- Gas range, wine fridge, quartz countertops- Washer and dryer in the butler's pantry- High-speed WiFi- Smart TVs throughout- Beach towels includedLOCATIONKingston Beach Club sits just steps from the Rosemary Beach Town Square, with its walkable stretch of restaurants, boutiques, and coffee shops. The private beach access point is a short stroll away. Whether your group is biking the 30A trail, grabbing dinner at Pescado, or spending the afternoon by the pool, this home puts you at the center of one of Florida's most beloved coastal communities.TDT-066488
